judgment_rule: Every listed component and its connecting relation must be visible together for PASS. Partial/unobservable evidence cannot pass a full gate. Technical discovery, prompt coverage, rendered fidelity and user acceptance are separate statuses.

pre_generation_gates.origin: current combined topic via exact prior-user antecedent
pre_generation_gates.pass_if: At least two rich materials or opulent display cues and at least one visibly worn/decayed cue share the same inhabited domestic collection scene.
pre_generation_gates.fail_if: Only generic dark decor or polished wealth appears; deterioration is absent or unobservable.

pre_generation_gates.origin: combined topic; the intercom mechanism is agent staging
pre_generation_gates.pass_if: A lived-in home and private collection are readable; the central figure holds a disconnected receiver and redirects attention toward a separate active-looking household intercom in the connected hallway. All relevant endpoints must be discernible.
pre_generation_gates.fail_if: It reads as museum/shop, generic portrait or simple telephone call; disconnection, second device, attention direction or spatial connection is absent/unobservable.
pre_generation_gates.scope_note: Failure can be a staging-legibility failure even when generic domestic suspense is visible.

pre_generation_gates.pass_if: A conspicuous irregular dark-red impact fan with multiple droplets or gravity trails reads as blood spatter on the display surfaces, rather than ordinary red decoration.
pre_generation_gates.fail_if: The red trace is absent, tiny, fully occluded, smooth decorative coloring or indeterminate.

pre_generation_gates.pass_if: Decadent display, intimate domestic threat and violent spatter visibly interact in one coherent photographic moment with a clear hierarchy.
pre_generation_gates.fail_if: Any theme is absent, or cues appear as unrelated montage/props with no perceptible relationship.

pre_generation_gates.origin: current request use of attached image; no identity or age claim
pre_generation_gates.pass_if: The actual provided reference is passed to the native tool and the generated central figure plausibly retains the observed short dark bob/fine bangs and facial proportions. Report resemblance qualitatively, never as confirmed identity.
pre_generation_gates.fail_if: Reference not passed, or hair/face guidance visibly diverges; ambiguous resemblance stays partial.

pre_generation_gates.pass_if: The receiver contact, acting hand/arm ownership, same-side cheek placement, freely hanging cut cord and separate supporting palm form one physically plausible, visibly connected state.
pre_generation_gates.fail_if: Contact/owner is inconsistent, cable is nonsensical, duplicated body parts appear, or consequential connections are unobservable.

pre_generation_gates.pass_if: Description-first review supports subtle everyday appeal, ordinary physical causality and restrained scene refinement; added fetish or clearly impossible effects are absent from the chosen realization.
pre_generation_gates.fail_if: A stronger erotic focus or overt impossible relationship leads the image, or the narrative is replaced beyond creativity=1 scope.

separate_evidence_checks.criterion: Save actual retrieved query/CID/RID/source-hash occurrences and every candidate-specific decision; new-topic result exposure alone does not prove image influence.
Record exact composed prompt, successful audits, native request with actual reference path/hash, one invocation, image SHA and current ledger entry.
View the actual saved full image, author observability for every gate and report scene-readable strengths/limitations independently of metadata PASS.
